_doc: The press at the selected rect's bottom-right corner (72,72) sets the shear AXIS from the reference point (36,36) to the press: the diagonal u = (1,1)/sqrt2 (SHEAR_TOOL.md, Drag). The drag of (+36, 0) has component -36/sqrt2 along perp(u) = (-1,1)/sqrt2, over an axis length of 36*sqrt2, so k = -0.5, and the matrix I + k*u*perp^T is [[1.25, -0.25], [0.25, 0.75]] about (36,36): a = 1.25, b = 0.25, c = -0.25, d = 0.75, e = f = 0.
name: shear_drag_along_diagonal
